name: Music practice and songbook
description: Practice logs, set lists, chord charts, lyric sheets and a songbook index.
note: This is a music practice and songbook project for a player or band: practice logs, set lists, chord charts in plain text or ChordPro, lyric sheets and the songbook. Notation in LilyPond belongs to the Music scores kind (score tool); this one is for the working musician's paperwork. Never invent lyrics, chords, keys, tempos or song lengths: take them from the files, and mark gaps. Do not reproduce the lyrics or charts of copyrighted songs from memory: work only on text the person gives you or owns. Transposing keeps the chord shapes and spelling: check unusual chords by ear. Warnings about key jumps or repeated tempos are prompts, not rules; a musician can overrule them. Say what you assumed, and run the check after every change.
details: The paperwork of playing. The Songbook tool summarises a practice log CSV (minutes per week and per piece, streaks, progress against a weekly goal), checks a set list CSV (running time against the slot, key jumps, the same tempo three songs in a row), transposes a plain-text chord chart or ChordPro file by semitones or to a key with sharps or flats chosen to suit and a capo suggestion, checks lyric sheets (unlabelled sections, missing verses, songs against the set list) and builds a songbook contents, alphabetical index and index by key in Markdown for Pandoc. It counts and edits text: it does not hear music. Sheet music in LilyPond is the Music scores kind (the Music scores tool); recordings' tempo and loudness are in the Music tool.
examples: Total my practice minutes this week against my goal
Will this set fit the 45-minute slot, and does it flow
Transpose the chart to G and suggest a capo
Build the songbook contents and index for printing
